purpose: Verify valid club creation accepts permitted categories and valid student and faculty assignments, and starts the club as open.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated. The user registry contains valid student leaders and a valid faculty member. The three permitted categories are available.
action_or_input: Create clubs using valid coordinator, co-coordinator, and Club Faculty Councillor assignments; use Technical, Sports, and Cultural across the clubs.
expected_result: All three clubs are created with the selected assignments and categories, and each has open status.

purpose: Verify club creation rejects invalid student leaders, invalid faculty assignments, and categories outside the permitted set.
preconditions: Student Admin is authenticated. The registry identifies invalid student and faculty records; a category outside Technical, Sports, and Cultural can be submitted.
action_or_input: Attempt club creation with an invalid coordinator, an invalid co-coordinator, an invalid faculty assignment, and an unsupported category, varying one invalid value per attempt.
expected_result: Each attempt is rejected; no club is created from an invalid assignment or category.

purpose: Verify only Student Admin approval changes an open club to confirmed.
preconditions: An open club exists. Student Admin and a non-Student-Admin user are authenticated in separate attempts.
action_or_input: Attempt to approve the club as the non-Student-Admin user, then approve it as Student Admin.
expected_result: The non-Student-Admin attempt does not confirm the club. Student Admin approval changes its status from open to confirmed.

purpose: Verify a leadership change uses valid replacement students and retires superseded current leadership assignments.
preconditions: A club has current coordinator and co-coordinator assignments. The applicable Club Head is authenticated, and replacement students are valid.
action_or_input: Change the coordinator and co-coordinator assignments to the replacement students.
expected_result: The replacement students are recorded as current leaders, and the superseded assignments are no longer current.

purpose: Verify an invalid replacement leader is rejected.
preconditions: A club has current leadership assignments. The applicable Club Head is authenticated, and the proposed replacement is not a valid student.
action_or_input: Submit a leadership change using the invalid replacement student.
expected_result: The change is rejected and current leadership assignments remain unchanged.

purpose: Verify booking start-time boundary behavior for sessions and events.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated and a configured venue is available.
action_or_input: For both a session and an event, submit one booking with start earlier than end, one with start equal to end, and one with start later than end.
expected_result: Bookings with start earlier than end are accepted. Bookings with equal or later start times are rejected.

purpose: Verify overlapping bookings in the same venue on the same date are rejected for every session/event pairing.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated. An existing booking is present at a configured venue and date.
action_or_input: Attempt overlapping bookings for session-session, event-event, and session-event pairings in that same venue on that date.
expected_result: Each overlapping booking is rejected.

purpose: Verify bookings are not rejected by the overlap rule when its venue, date, or time-overlap condition is absent.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated. An existing booking is present at a configured venue.
action_or_input: Submit overlapping-time bookings at a different venue and on a different date, and submit a non-overlapping booking at the same venue and date.
expected_result: Each booking is accepted because it does not overlap an existing booking in the same venue on the same date.

purpose: Verify sessions and events accept configured venues and reject unconfigured venues.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated. At least one configured and one unconfigured venue value can be submitted.
action_or_input: For both a session and an event, submit a booking using a configured venue and then one using an unconfigured venue.
expected_result: Bookings using configured venues are accepted; bookings using unconfigured venues are rejected.

purpose: Verify newly booked sessions and events produce notifications.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated, configured venues are available, and the shared notification service is operational.
action_or_input: Successfully book one session and one event.
expected_result: A notification is produced for each newly booked session and event.

purpose: Verify membership applications are allowed only for confirmed clubs.
preconditions: A student is authenticated. One club is open and another club is confirmed.
action_or_input: Apply for membership to each club.
expected_result: The application to the confirmed club is accepted; the application to the open club is not accepted.

purpose: Verify applications to different clubs are allowed while a duplicate same-club application is rejected without changing membership state.
preconditions: A student is authenticated and two clubs are confirmed.
action_or_input: Apply to the first club, apply to the second club, then submit another application to the first club.
expected_result: The applications to both different clubs are accepted. The duplicate application to the first club is rejected, and its membership state remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify Club Head operations are authorized only for the applicable coordinator or co-coordinator.
preconditions: A club has an applicable coordinator and co-coordinator. A different authenticated user is not assigned either role.
action_or_input: Have the coordinator and co-coordinator each perform a Club Head operation for the club, then have the other user attempt the same operation.
expected_result: The coordinator and co-coordinator are authorized; the other user is not authorized.

purpose: Verify approval confirms an open membership application and retains remarks when provided.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated. Two open membership applications exist for the club.
action_or_input: Approve one application with optional remarks and approve the other without remarks.
expected_result: Both selected applications change from open to confirmed. Remarks are retained for the application where provided.

purpose: Verify the minimum poll-choice threshold.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated.
action_or_input: Submit a poll with one choice and a poll with exactly two choices.
expected_result: The one-choice poll is not created; the two-choice poll is created.

purpose: Verify poll notifications and access are restricted to the selected batch and branch audience.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated. Students exist in the selected batch/branch audience and outside that audience.
action_or_input: Create a poll targeting a selected batch and branch, then check notification and poll access for students inside and outside the selected groups.
expected_result: The selected groups determine the poll's intended notification recipients and access audience; students outside the selected groups are not included.

purpose: Verify the all-branches selection represents all branches where that selection is supported.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated. The poll targeting interface supports an all-branches selection for a batch.
action_or_input: Create a poll for a selected batch using the all-branches selection and check its notification and access audience.
expected_result: The poll audience includes the selected batch across all branches represented by that selection.

purpose: Verify poll participation requires an active, unexpired poll and membership in its selected audience.
preconditions: A student is authenticated. Test polls are available that vary active status, expiry, and target-audience membership.
action_or_input: Request poll details and submit a vote for an active, unexpired poll where the student is in the audience; repeat for an inactive poll, an expired poll, and an active unexpired poll where the student is outside the audience.
expected_result: Participation is allowed only for the active, unexpired poll whose audience includes the student. The other details/vote requests are not allowed.

purpose: Verify a student may vote at most once in a poll.
preconditions: A student is eligible for an active, unexpired poll and has not voted in it.
action_or_input: Submit a vote, then submit another vote in the same poll as the same student.
expected_result: The first vote is accepted; the second vote is rejected.

purpose: Verify a zero-amount budget request with its required file is accepted and retained.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated and the required supporting file is available.
action_or_input: Submit a club budget request with amount zero and the required supporting file.
expected_result: The request is accepted and retained with amount zero and its supporting file.

purpose: Verify a negative club budget amount is rejected.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated and the required supporting file is available.
action_or_input: Submit a club budget request with a negative amount and the required supporting file.
expected_result: The request is rejected.

purpose: Verify a budget request without its required supporting file is rejected.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated.
action_or_input: Submit a club budget request with a non-negative amount and no supporting file.
expected_result: The request is rejected.

purpose: Verify an invalid faculty member cannot be used in an event context.
preconditions: An event context requires a Club Faculty Councillor, and the selected faculty record is invalid.
action_or_input: Attempt to use the invalid faculty member in the event context.
expected_result: The operation is rejected or stopped because the faculty member is invalid.

source_id: BR-GYM-019; BR-GYM-021; Problem Statement §3.5 Event Reporting
purpose: Verify an event report with its required file is submitted, retained centrally, and accessible to the assigned Club Faculty Councillor.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated. The club has an assigned valid Club Faculty Councillor, and the report/details file is available.
action_or_input: Submit an event report with its required file, then open the submitted report as the assigned Club Faculty Councillor.
expected_result: The report is accepted and retained in the centralized repository; the assigned Club Faculty Councillor can access and review it.

purpose: Verify an event report without its required report/details file is rejected.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated.
action_or_input: Submit an event report without the required report/details file.
expected_result: The report submission is rejected.

purpose: Verify a faculty member assigned to another club cannot review the report.
preconditions: A submitted report exists for a club, and the authenticated faculty member is not that club's assigned Club Faculty Councillor.
action_or_input: Attempt to open the report for review.
expected_result: Access is not allowed.
